players.product: AI data-center colocation (Tydal, Norway: 121 IT MW leased to Volta for NVIDIA GPUs) and Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / Vera Rubin capacity in Malaysia, Norway and the US)

quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer AI Expands Southeast Asia Footprint with A901, a (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Bitdeer AI entered into a 10-year data center services agreement for A901, a 67MW AI Cloud data center campus in Malaysia (a third Malaysian hub alongside Cyberjaya and Johor), to be engineered for liquid-cooled, rack-scale NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems; delivery of A901 capacity is targeted to commence in Q1 2027, with delivery of the full 67MW targeted for Q2 2027. Secured AI Cloud data center capacity (owned or under an executed data center services agreement) now totals approximately 273.5MW across Malaysia, Norway and the United States, approximately 78% of its target of up to 350MW to be delivered by Q1 2028 (critical IT load).
quarterly_data.figure: A901 67MW (delivery from Q1 2027, full 67MW Q2 2027); secured ~273.5MW, ~78% of up-to-350MW target by Q1 2028

quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer AI Expands Southeast Asia Footprint with A901, a (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Bitdeer AI: demand for uncontracted capacity across its AI Cloud sites remains strong; its active pipeline for AI Cloud capacity is now estimated to exceed $10 billion, and it expects the pipeline to continue to increase (contract value per megawatt varies with service mix, contract duration and site). CFO Michael G. Potter: demand for liquid-cooled, rack-scale AI capacity in Southeast Asia 'is running ahead of what the market can deliver, and customers are asking for it earlier and in larger blocks.'
quarterly_data.figure: active AI Cloud pipeline exceeds $10 billion
